articles.title: World Models' Last Exam in Physics
articles.content: Video world models can produce visually convincing yet physically inconsistent sequences, raising concerns about their reliability for prediction and planning in embodied AI systems. Existing evaluations often rely on model-based judgments or reference videos, while direct physical tests largely focus on mechanics. We introduce World Models' Last Exam in Physics, a measurement-based benchmark for evaluating physical consistency in video world models. The benchmark comprises 40 controlled tasks spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, thermal and phase-change phenomena, electromagnetism, and surface tension. Each task pairs an initial image and a generation prompt with predefined physical criteria, enabling interpretable tests of observable physical relationships without requiring reference videos. Its evaluator combines task-observability screening with task-specific quantitative physical measurements. Experiments on eight video generation models across 1,280 videos reveal persistent physical inconsistencies and substantial variation across tasks, with the best model achieving an overall score of 57.76 out of 100. Evaluation on synthetic videos with known physical relationships provides evidence for the validity of the measurement module under controlled conditions. The evaluator also achieves higher agreement with human judgments than a direct vision-language model baseline in both within-task rankings and pairwise comparisons. By combining coverage across physical domains with scores grounded in measurable evidence and explicit measurement limitations, the benchmark provides an interpretable basis for diagnosing physical inconsistencies and tracking progress toward physically consistent video world models.

articles.title_zh: 世界物理学模型的最后考试
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模型可以产生视觉上令人信服但物理上不一致的序列,引起人们对它们对于所体现AI系统中的预测和规划的可靠性的关切. 现有的评价往往依赖于基于模型的判断或参考视频,而直接的物理测试则主要侧重于力学. 我们介绍了世界模型物理学最后考试,这是评价视频世界模型中物理一致性的一个基于测量的基准. 该基准包括40个可控制的任务,涉及机械、光学、流体、热和相变现象、电磁和地表张力。 每个任务将一个初始图像和一个带有预先定义的物理标准的一代即时对齐,使得可以对可观察到的物理关系进行可解释的测试而不需要参考视频. 其评估人员将任务可观测性筛选与针对具体任务的定量物理测量相结合. 对1,280个视频的8个视频生成模型的实验显示,各任务之间持续存在物理上的差异和巨大差异,最佳模型的总得分达到57.76分. 对已知物理关系的合成视频的评价为测量模块在受控条件下的有效性提供了证据. 在任务内部的排名和对等比较中,评价人员对人的判断也比直接的视觉语言模型基线更为一致。 该基准将物理域的覆盖范围与基于可计量证据的分数和明确的计量限制相结合,为诊断物理不一致情况并跟踪实现物理一致的视频世界模型的进展提供了可解释的基础。

articles.title: Building Rome from a Single Image
articles.content: Single-image scene generation aims to produce a complete 3D scene mesh from a single image, including surfaces the camera did not observe. While pretrained 3D object generators encode a strong shape prior, they are mainly designed for isolated objects in a fixed canonical volume and focus mostly on indoor scenes, since diverse 3D data for outdoor scenes are quite limited. In this work, we present a method that redesigns such an object-centric generator, e.g., Trellis 2, to work on both indoor and outdoor scenes while retaining its prior. We accomplish this by (a) partitioning the scene into adaptive chunks that scale relative to the distance to the camera; nearby chunks have a smaller size to keep the finer detail, while distant structures, e.g., buildings, are covered by large chunks; (b) making the generator capture explicit 2D-3D correspondence by lifting image features and making the model aware of the free space, observed surface, and unobserved region; (c) synthesizing around 4,000 outdoor scenes to broaden the training data, as existing scene datasets are largely indoor. Experiments on Tanks and Temples, ScanNet++, and in-the-wild images show that our method outperforms all baselines in geometric accuracy and perceptual quality across both indoor and outdoor scenes.

articles.title_zh: 从单一图像构建罗马
articles.content_zh: 单相相片场景生成旨在从单一相片中产生完整的3D相片网格,包括相机没有观测到的表面. 虽然预先训练的3D物体发生器在前作中编码了强烈的外形,但它们主要是为固定的犬形体积中被隔离的物体所设计,并主要专注于室内场景,因为户外场景的多种3D数据相当有限. 在这项工作中,我们提出了一种方法,重新设计这种以物体为中心的发电机,例如Trellis 2,在保持其前作的同时,在室内外的场景上工作。 我们通过以下方式做到这一点:(a) 将场景分割成适应性块,相对于相机的相距范围;附近的块有较小的尺寸来保持更细细的细节,而远处的结构,例如建筑物,则被大块所覆盖;(b) 使发电机能够清晰地捕捉2D-3D通信,方法是提升图像特性并让模型了解自由空间、观测到的地表和无人观察的区域;(c) 合成大约4 000个室外场景,以扩大培训数据,因为现有的场景数据集大多在室内。 在Tanks and Temples、ScanNet++上的实验,以及无所不包的图像显示,我们的方法在几何精确度和感知质量上超越了室内外场景的所有基线。

articles.title: 4D-HOF: Hand-Object Flow Matching for Feed-Forward 4D Interaction Reconstruction
articles.content: Existing methods for 4D hand-object reconstruction often rely on costly per-sequence optimization, while generative approaches typically synthesize interactions from random noise, which can lead to unstable interaction prediction. We introduce 4D-HOF, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs 4D hand-object interactions from coarse but informative estimates produced by vision foundation models. Concretely, we learn a conditional flow matching model that transports foundation-model-derived hand-object states toward an interaction manifold, allowing the model to correct errors in translation, rotation, and alignment in a feed-forward manner. A key advantage of our generative formulation is that it naturally enables test-time guidance within the transport process. Rather than applying a separate post-hoc optimization after reconstruction, we directly steer the evolving generative states using physical interaction constraints and observed 2D evidence, allowing the reconstruction to be refined as part of the generative process itself. By training the generative model on diverse datasets, 4D-HOF generalizes robustly to challenging in-the-wild scenarios. Experiments on out-of-domain benchmarks show that 4D-HOF achieves state-of-the-art performance, producing more stable and accurate 4D hand-object reconstructions.

articles.title_zh: 4D -HOF: 手 - 手 Feed-Forward 4D 交互重建对象流匹配
articles.content_zh: 4D手物重建的现有方法往往依赖于昂贵的每序列优化,而基因方法一般会从随机噪声中合成相互作用,这可能导致不稳定的相互作用预测. 我们引入了4D-HOF,这是一个向导的框架,它重建了由视觉基础模型产生的粗糙但信息丰富的估计产生的4D手取物相互作用. 具体地说,我们学习了一个有条件的流相匹配模式,将基建模型衍生的手目标状态转移到交互多点上,使模型能够以向导的方式纠正翻译、旋转和对齐中的错误。 我们基因配制的一个关键优势是,它自然可以在运输过程中提供试验时间指导。 我们不是在重建后采用单独的后热优化,而是利用物理相互作用的限制和观察到的2D证据,直接引导不断演变的基因状态,使重建作为基因过程本身的一部分得到完善. 通过对不同数据集的基因模型进行培训,4D-HOF将强力地概括为挑战万事俱备的情景. 关于域外基准的实验显示,4D-HOF实现了最先进的性能,产生了更稳定和准确的4D手取物重建.

articles.title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
articles.content: World models offer a data-driven alternative to traditional simulators for robotics, with applications spanning policy evaluation, improvement, and planning. All of these uses depend on faithful 3D geometry, yet current video-based world models are trained on RGB alone and produce rollouts that look correct frame-by-frame but do not compose into a consistent 3D world. Closing this gap requires progress on two fronts: large-scale 3D supervision for manipulation, and an architecture that can absorb it without disturbing strong pretrained video priors. We introduce a calibration pipeline that combines learned stereo depth with a joint factor graph, pooling all episodes collected from the same physical robot to recover its shared kinematic parameters alongside per-scene extrinsics. Applied to the DROID dataset, this yields DROID-3D, a calibrated 3D dataset providing dense metric depth and recalibrated multi-view extrinsics (achieving <0.7 px reprojection error on 90% of episodes for external cameras). We then train DepthWorld, a Stable Video Diffusion-based world model that jointly predicts multi-view RGB and depth via spatial latent tiling, leaving the pretrained Variational Autoencoder (VAE) unchanged. Depth supervision improves RGB prediction itself by +1.48 dB PSNR over an identical RGB-only baseline at equal training budget, while simultaneously yielding accurate metric depth for downstream geometric reasoning.

articles.title_zh: 深度世界 : 3D 机器人操纵世界模型
articles.content_zh: 世界模型提供了一种数据驱动的机器人传统模拟器替代品,其应用包括政策评价、改进和规划。 所有这些用途都依赖于忠实的3D几何学,然而目前的以视频为基础的世界模型仅接受RGB的培训,并产生逐帧显示正确但并不构成一致的3D世界的推出. 缩小这一差距需要在两个方面取得进展:对操纵进行大规模三维监督,以及一个可以吸收这一差距而不会扰乱经过事先训练的强力视频前传的架构. 我们引入了一个校正管道,将学习到的立体深度和联合因子图结合起来,把从同一个物理机器人收集的所有场景集中起来,与每个场景外观一起恢复其共享的动能参数。 应用到 DROID 数据集中,它产生 DROID-3D,一个校准的3D 数据集,提供密集的公尺深度并重新校正多视图外观(实现<0.7 px再预测90%的外相相机出错). 然后我们训练了深度世界(DepthWorld),一个基于稳定视频扩散的世界模型,它通过空间潜伏地平板共同预测多视图RGB和深度,使预先训练的变相自编码器(VAE)保持不变. 深度监督通过+1.48 dB PSNR改进了RGB的预测本身,在同等培训预算下,相对于一个相同的RGB唯一基线,同时得出下游几何推理的准确度量深度.

articles.title: ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing
articles.content: Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated. We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects "alive" through coherent interactions with the source video's contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. Each pair differs in the target object's presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation. We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs. We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.

articles.title_zh: 活性: 用于第一Frame- Guided 的交互相通对象插入 视频编辑
articles.content_zh: 目前的视频编辑器可以插入对象,但往往会挣扎地让他们参与互动,如被取出或被操纵. 我们引入了ALIVE,这个框架通过与源视频内容的连贯互动,使被插入对象"活性",使用被编辑的第一个帧和一个只命名被添加对象的指令. 我们整理了35,800对编辑配对, 结合了3D的,模型生成的, 和现实世界的视频 和ROSE的普通编辑配对。 每个对子在目标对象的存在上都有所不同,同时保留了周围的动作,教学编辑器协调对象行为和源保存. 我们进一步培训一种视觉语言模型(VLM),以预测来自相同投入的互动指导。 我们采用ALIVE-Interactive基准,用一个统一的基于VLM的协议来评估互动的忠诚性,源保存和视觉的一致性,并在一般视频对象插入基准上进行评估. 没有VLM指导,生存改善 总体来看,在两个基准上,评价最强的基准分别增加了43.9%和4.4%。 VLM所预想的指导,在不增加用户输入的情况下,将ALIVE互动分数进一步提高了0.95分.

articles.title: CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching
articles.content: Interactive video world models need to generate each video chunk efficiently while responding faithfully to user controls. Many systems use chunk-wise autoregressive generation with few-step denoising, but each chunk still requires several costly denoising iterations. Training-free caching can reduce this cost, yet existing policies make reuse decisions primarily from model-internal denoising dynamics and do not explicitly account for control transitions. Actually, interactive generation explicitly exposes a signal they do not use: the controls for a chunk arrive before it is denoised, so a schedule derived from them costs no forward pass. To this end, we analyze adjacent chunks under different control regimes and find that structural similarity drops around action changes, while low-frequency structure remains more persistent than high-frequency detail. Motivated by these observations, we propose CtrlCache, a training-free control-aware caching framework that adapts computation to the current control sequence. Specifically, the action-aware scheduling and refresh policy detects action changes across and within chunks, and labels each chunk as initial, transition, turning, or steady state. At one selected interior denoising step, initial and transition chunks retain full computation, while turning and steady chunks reuse the transformer residual from the most recent fully computed step in the same chunk. To exploit the persistence of low-frequency structure during steady interaction, we further introduce a frequency-mixed history prior guidance that incorporates complementary information from the preceding clean latent without an additional DiT forward pass. Evaluated on Matrix-Game 2.0 and LingBot-World v1/v2, CtrlCache achieves 1.21x to 1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without model retraining while improving WBench Overall scores over original inference across all three models.

articles.title_zh: CtrlCache: 加速互动视频世界模式与控制- 智能缓存
articles.content_zh: 互动视频世界模型需要高效生成每个视频块,同时忠实地响应用户控制. 许多系统采用分块自动递减生成,少步去诺,但每个分块仍然需要若干个昂贵的去诺再递增. 无培训的缓存可降低这一成本,但现行政策主要通过模型-内部解密动态作出再利用决定,并且没有明确说明控制过渡。 实际上,交互生成明确暴露了他们不使用的一个信号:一个块的控件在解密前到达,因此从它们中得出的时间表不会花费前传. 为此,我们分析不同控制体制下相邻块并发现结构相似性会围绕动作变化下降,而低频结构仍然比高频细节更持久. 基于这些观察,我们提出CtrlCache,一个能适应当前控制序列的无训练控制-意识缓存框架. 具体地说,意识到行动的时间安排和刷新政策检测出块之间和块之内的行动变化,并将每个块标为初始状态、过渡状态、转变状态或平稳状态。 在一个选定的内部去Noing步骤中,初始和过渡块保留了完全的计算,而转换和稳定块则从同一块中最近完全计算的步骤再利用变压器剩余部分。 为了利用稳定互动期间低频结构的持久性,我们进一步引入了频相混合历史前导,其中包含来自先前清洁潜伏的辅助信息,而没有额外的DiT前传. 对Matrix-Game 2.0和LingBot-World v1/v2进行了评价,CtrlCache实现了1.21x到1.41x. 迪T-后骨加速不进行模型再培训,同时改进了W Bench 总体得分高于所有三种模型的原始推论.

articles.title: Backend-Agnostic Sparse Attention for Fast High-Resolution Visual Generation
articles.content: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in image and video generation, but the quadratic complexity of full attention makes high-resolution generation computationally expensive. Window attention offers an efficient alternative, yet existing methods face a practical trade-off: partitioned window attention typically achieves computational efficiency consistent with its theoretical complexity. However, isolated windows block cross-window interaction, often introducing visible grid-like artifacts in the generated results. Fine-grained sliding-window attention effectively restores interactions across neighboring windows and improves visual quality. However, its irregular computation patterns create a substantial gap between theoretical and practical speedups and require specialized kernels tailored to each hardware backend. To tackle these challenges, we propose BASA, a backend-agnostic sparse attention, which brings the best of both worlds: visual quality and practical acceleration. Specifically, BASA replaces visual self-attention with shifted local-window attention. By introducing a structured window-shifting scheme across DiT blocks, we allow tokens divided by window boundaries in one layer to communicate in the following layers, thereby achieving global information exchange and eliminating window-induced visual artifacts. Notably, our design introduces no additional irregular operators or customized kernels, making it readily deployable on existing attention backends and closing the gap between theoretical sparsity and practical acceleration. Experiments demonstrate that BASA achieves measured speedups exceeding 90\% of the theoretical estimates on FLUX and delivers a 4.52$\times$ attention speedup on Wan while maintaining competitive generation quality.

articles.title_zh: 后端- 不可知析 Sparse 注意快高分辨率视觉生成
articles.content_zh: 扩散变形器(DiTs)在图像和视频生成上取得了强大的性能,但全注意力的四相复杂使得高分辨率生成在计算上昂贵. 窗口关注提供了一个高效的替代方案,然而现有的方法面临着一种实际的取舍:被分割的窗口关注通常能达到与其理论复杂性相符合的计算效率. 然而,被隔离的窗户会阻碍跨窗口的相互作用,往往会在所生成的结果中引入可见的网格等文物. 精细的滑窗关注有效地恢复了相邻窗口之间的相互作用并提升了视觉质量. 然而,其不规则的计算模式在理论速度与实际速度之间造成了巨大的差距,并且需要适合每个硬件后端的专门内核. 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议BASA,这是一种后端-不可知的稀有关注,它带来两个世界中最好的:视觉质量和实际加速. 具体而言,BASA用转移的本地窗口注意力来取代视觉自觉. 通过在DiT区块中引入结构化的窗口转换方案,我们允许以窗口分出分出一层的符号在下层进行交流,从而实现全球信息交换并消除由窗口引起的视觉文物. 值得注意的是,我们的设计没有引入额外的不规则操作器或定制的内核,使它可以随时被部署在现有关注的后端上,并缩小理论上的收缩与实际加速之间的差距。 实验表明,BASA在FLUX上测得的速度超过了理论估计的90分,在保持有竞争力的生成质量的同时,对Wan提供了4.52美元\times的注意速度.

articles.title: Data Leakage in Patch-Based Hyperspectral Image Classification: Quantifying the Impact of Spatial Overlap
articles.content: Patch-based learning improves hyperspectral image (HSI) classification by exploiting local spectral-spatial information, but random train-test sampling from the same image can cause spatial patch overlap, leading to data leakage and optimistic performance estimates. This paper investigates same-class train-test spatial overlap in patch-based HSI classification using two measures: overlap percentage (OP), which quantifies the global amount of overlapped testing patch pixels, and average overlap ratio (AOR), which measures the local severity among affected testing patches. Experiments on the Pavia University dataset compare random and non-random spatial sampling using SVM, MLP, 2D-CNN, 3D-CNN, ViT, and MorpMamba. The results show that deep patch-based models achieve high accuracy under random sampling, with 3D-CNN reaching 96.17% Overall Accuracy (OA), but drop substantially under non-random spatial sampling, where 3D-CNN decreases to 55.20% and ViT and 2D-CNN drop by 40.71 and 38.81 percentage points (PP), respectively. Patch-size analysis further shows that increasing the patch size from 5x5 to 19x19 raises the random-sampling overlap percentage from 23.28% to 77.02%. These findings demonstrate that random patch-based evaluation can substantially inflate classification performance, especially for models that strongly exploit spatial context. The code associated with this paper is available at: https://github.com/mqalkhatib/Data_Leakage_in_HSI_Classification.

articles.title_zh: 基于补丁的超光谱数据泄漏 图像分类 : 量化空间重叠的影响
articles.content_zh: 基于补丁的学习通过利用本地光谱-空间信息来改进超光谱成像(HSI)的分类,但从同一张图像中随机的列车测试采样会导致空间补丁重叠,导致数据泄露和乐观的性能估计. 本文调查了同级列车在基于补丁的HSI分类中的空间重叠情况,采用两种衡量方法:重叠百分比(OP),它量化了全球重叠的测试补丁像素数量;平均重叠比率(AOR),它测量了受影响的测试补丁中的局部严重性. 帕维亚大学数据集上的实验利用SVM,MLP,2D-CNN,3D-CNN,ViT,和MorpMamba进行随机和非随机空间采样比较. 结果显示,以深补丁为基础的模型在随机采样下达到高精度,3D-CNN总精确度达到96.17%,但在非随机空间采样下大幅下降,3D-CNN下降至55.20%,而ViT和2D-CNN分别下降40.71和38.81个百分点. 补丁大小分析进一步显示,将补丁大小从5x5提高到19x19,将随机抽样重叠百分比从23.28%提高到77.02%. 这些调查结果表明,基于补丁的随机评价可大幅提升分类性能,特别是对于大力利用空间环境的模型而言。 与本文相关的代码可在以下网站查阅: https://github.com/mqalkhatib/Data_Leakage_in_HSI_Classification.

articles.title: WorldSonus: Bringing Sound to Worlds
articles.content: Recent advances in world models have enabled increasingly realistic visual synthesis. However, these generated environments remain largely silent. Bringing sound to world models poses three core challenges: real-time generation to keep pace with interactive video streams, interactive control to respond to mid-stream sound instructions, and spatially aligned stereo to reflect scene geometry and camera motion. To address these demands, we introduce WorldSonus, an interactive video-to-audio framework designed for real-time spatial sound synthesis in world models. For real-time generation, WorldSonus employs a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that synthesizes audio chunks at a low real-time factor (RTF) of 0.41. For interactive control, we incorporate an audio-centric captioning pipeline with chunk-indexed prompt scheduling, enabling dynamic manipulation of sound events during generation. For spatial alignment, we leverage high-quality stereo supervision curated from diverse stereo and ambisonic data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while tailored for world models, WorldSonus generalizes effectively to open-domain video-to-audio benchmarks, matching or outperforming state-of-the-art bidirectional models in both acoustic quality and spatial alignment. Project page: https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/

articles.title_zh: WorldSonus:将声音带入世界
articles.content_zh: 最近世界模型的进步使得视觉合成变得日益现实。 然而,这些产生的环境基本上保持沉默。 将声音带入世界模型提出了三个核心挑战:实时生成以跟上交互式视频流,交互控制以响应中流音指令,空间对接立体以反映场景几何和相机运动. 为应对这些需要,我们引入了WorldSonus,这是一个交互式的视频到音频框架,旨在为世界模型中的实时空间声音合成而设计. 对于实时生成,WorldSonus使用流出因子自旋扩散架构,以0.41的低实时因子(RTF)合成音频块. 为了进行互动控制,我们采用了以音频为中心的标题管道,并采用块索引的即时排出,从而能够在生成期间动态地操纵声音事件。 在空间对接方面,我们利用来自各种立体声和声波数据的高质量立体声监督。 广泛的实验表明,WorldSonus虽然适合世界模型,但能有效地实现开放域的视频对音频基准,在声学质量和空间对接方面匹配或优于最先进的双向模型。 项目网页:https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/

articles.title: Post-Training Semantic Lifting for 3D Gaussian Splatting: Separating Detector, Lifting and Representation Error
articles.content: The same Gaussian of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model is seen from many views, and these views do not always agree on the class it belongs to. The Gaussian may be occluded in some of them, and the confidence of the detector is not the same from one view to another. The ground truth, on the other hand, is given as an annotated mesh, because two training runs do not produce the same Gaussians. In this work, we propose a post-training lifting method that works with one target class at a time and combines the information coming from all the views. Target and non-target evidence are accumulated simultaneously, weighted by the visibility of each Gaussian in each view. After that, the Gaussians are filtered with two thresholds: a main threshold $β$ selects the high-confidence seeds, and a lower one $γβ$ adds the connected components around them. For the evaluation, the labels are transferred from the Gaussians to the mesh vertices that are both visible and annotated. With this design, we can separate three sources of error: the 2D detector, the lifting and the transfer between representations. The thresholds and the transfer operator are chosen on seven Replica validation scenes, and the method is evaluated on ten held-out ScanNet++ scenes with the same values for every scene and class. The mean mIoU on the validation scenes was 0.93 with masks from the dataset annotations and 0.65 with YOLO masks, and on the ScanNet++ test scenes it was 0.80 and 0.54. Compared with thresholding the evidence per view, as a previous version of the method did, the fraction improves the test mIoU by 0.24 and makes it possible to use a single threshold for all the classes and scenes of both datasets. Finally, the error analysis shows that most of the remaining error comes from the detector.

articles.title_zh: 3D高斯电镀的后训练语义提升:分离检测器,提升和代表错误
articles.content_zh: 3D高斯平板模型的同名高斯平板模型从许多观点中可以看出来,这些观点并不总是认同它所属的类. 高斯人可能会被部分人所吞噬,而从一个视角到另一个视角,探测器的信心并不相同. 而地上真相则作为注解的网目给出,因为两次训练赛跑并不产生相同的高斯人. 在这项工作中,我们提出一个训练后提升方法,它一次与一个目标班一起工作,并结合来自各种观点的信息. 目标证据和非目标证据同时被累积,以每个高斯人在每个视图中的能见度来加权. 之后,高斯人被过滤出两个阈值:一个主阈值为β美元,选择高自信种子;一个更低的$为+美元,增加周围相接组件. 对于评价,标签从高斯人转移到有可见和注释的网状顶点. 通过这种设计,我们可以分离出三个出错源:2D探测器,起重和表示器之间的转移. 阈值和传输运算符被选择在7个复制验证场景上,该方法被评价在10个被搁置的ScanNet++场景上,每个场景和类的数值相同. 验证场景上的平均mIoU为:从数据集说明中取出口罩0.93个;用YOLO口罩0.65个;在ScanNet++测试场景上取出0.80个和0.54个. 相较于每个视图对证据的阈值,和之前版本的方法一样,分数将测试mIoU改进了0.24并使得对两个数据集的所有类别和场景使用单一阈值成为可能. 最后,出错分析显示所剩出错大多出自探测器.

articles.title: Co-Evolving Paths and Flows via Path-Flow Alignment
articles.content: We study path-flow alignment as a unified training objective for flow matching. Instead of fixing the interpolation path and learning only the velocity field, we jointly train an endpoint-preserving path network and a flow network using the same alignment loss: the flow learns to match the path velocity, and the path learns to align its velocity to the current flow. Although every fixed learned path defines a valid flow-matching objective, the alignment loss alone is not a reliable criterion for path learning. We identify path overfitting, a failure mode in which the alignment loss decreases while sample quality worsens. We find that this failure is associated with low-entropy bottlenecks in the induced probability path, where the learned path routes samples through overly concentrated intermediate marginals. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce a stochastic path regularizer that hides part of the source information from the path network while preserving exact endpoints. The resulting regularization gives an explicit entropy floor for the stochastic training-path marginals and empirically suppresses the bottleneck in the learned sampler, making joint path-flow training effective. On ImageNet-256x256 with SiT backbones, our method consistently improves FID across model scales, extends to model-guidance training, and leaves the inference-time architecture and sampler unchanged. Code is available at https://github.com/lizeyu090312/traj_opt_paper

articles.title_zh: 通过路径-花序对齐进行路径和流动
articles.content_zh: 我们研究路径-流量对接,作为流量对接的统一训练目标. 我们没有固定插道并只学习速度场,而是联合训练一个端点保留路径网络和一个使用相同对齐损失的流网:流会学习与路径速度相匹配,而路径会学习使其速度与当前流相匹配. 虽然每一个固定的学习路径都定义了一个有效的流相匹配目标,但单靠对齐损失并不是路径学习的可靠标准. 我们发现路径过于匹配,这是一种失败模式,即校正损失减少而样本质量恶化。 我们发现这种失败与诱发概率道的低通向性瓶颈有关,所学道道通过过度集中的中间边际来取样. 受这个诊断的驱使,我们引入了一种有花纹的路径调节器,它从路径网络中隐藏了部分源信息,同时保留了准确的终点. 由此而来的规范化为斯多克特式的训练-路径边际提供了明确的py底,在经验上抑制了所学取样器中的瓶颈,使联合路径-流程训练有效. 在具有SiT主干线的ImageNet-256x256上,我们的方法不断改进跨模型尺度的FID,延伸至模型指导培训,使推论时间架构和取样器保持不变. 代码见https://github.com/lizeyu090312/traj_opt_paper

articles.title: SpaTime: Streaming Vision-Language Models for Spatio-temporal Reasoning
articles.content: Embodied agents must reason about 3D space while the video is still arriving, answering questions as soon as they have observed enough of the scene. VLMs that incorporate 3D geometric priors achieve strong spatial reasoning, but they operate offline, i.e., the full video must be available before they produce an answer. Streaming VLMs process frames causally and decide for themselves when to respond, yet they lack explicit 3D representations. We present SpaTime, a streaming VLM that fuses causal geometry tokens into the language model at every frame, using only the frames observed so far. To supervise when the model answers, we propose a response-time loss that maps per-frame response probabilities to a differentiable expected response time and penalizes the distance from the ground-truth frame. For evaluation, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench, streaming adaptations of VSTI-Bench and VSI-Bench. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy and reduces the mean response-time error by 66% relative to the strongest streaming baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Spatime:流线视-时空推理模型
articles.content_zh: 健壮的特工必须说明3D空间的原因,而视频还在到来时,只要他们已经对现场进行了足够的观察,就立即回答问题. 包含3D几何前缀的VLM实现了强大的空间推理,但它们运行在离线,即,完整视频必须在生成答案之前提供. 将VLMs进程框架因果地流出,自行决定何时应答,然而它们却缺乏明确的三维表达. 我们呈现的是SpaTime,一种流式的VLM,它将因果几何符号融合到每个帧的语言模型中,只使用迄今为止观测到的帧. 为了监督模型何时回答,我们提议一个响应时间损失,将每帧响应的概率与不同的预期响应时间相映射,并惩罚与地面真实框架的距离。 为了评价,我们建造了StreamVSTI-Bench和StreamVSI-Bench,对VSTI-Bench和VSI-Bench进行流派改造。 在StreatVSTI-Bench上,SpaTime达到49.2%的总精度,相对于最强的流线基线将平均响应-时差减少66%.

articles.title: Local Content-Style Control for Diffusion-based Image Stylization
articles.content: Image stylization with latent-diffusion models entangles two independently refined axes: what a region depicts and how it is depicted. Such pipelines expose only global controls, yet professional retouching demands deliberate, region-specific control. We lift two conditioning weights already present in a ControlNet + IP-Adapter stylization pipeline from global scalars to per-location spatial maps, yielding local, per-axis control of content and style in a single generative pass. Because the two weights act on disjoint pathways, adjusting them independently spans a 2x2 retouching vocabulary, from free regeneration to identity preservation. We validate that edits stay confined to the retouched region and that each weight predominantly steers its own axis. Our approach requires no retraining and drops unchanged into any such pipeline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基于分泌的图像 Stylization 本地内容样式控制
articles.content_zh: 用潜在扩散模型进行图像分层化将两个独立的精细轴缠住:一个区域如何描绘和如何描绘. 这种管道只暴露出全球控制,而专业的调整要求则是针对特定区域的蓄意控制。 我们提升了ControlNet + IP-Adapter stylization管道中已经存在的两个调制权重,从全球分层到每个位置的空间图,以单一基因传入的方式产生对内容和风格的局部,每轴控制. 由于这两个重力作用于脱节路径,因此独立地调整它们跨越了从自由再生到身份保存的2x2重排词汇. 我们验证的是,编辑仍限于被调整的区域,而且每个重量主要支配自己的轴心。 我们的做法不需要再培训,也不改变任何这种管道。

articles.title: RenderBench: Benchmarking Render-to-Real Video Transfer with Reconstructed Digital Twins
articles.content: Modern video models can generate realistic videos from real appearance references and proxy renders that specify scene structure, viewpoint changes, and motion. Evaluating this render-to-real capability requires a real target video depicting the same scene evolution, paired with an editable, geometrically registered 3D replica. Such data has traditionally required substantial manual modeling, calibration, and animation effort. We introduce RenderBench, a benchmark of 12 reconstructed real-world scenes spanning large-scale indoor environments and egocentric viewpoints, with both static and dynamic settings. Our construction pipeline combines visual geometry, neural reconstruction, and assisted 3D authoring. Each scene is decomposed into static objects and dynamic actors, registered to the capture cameras, and accepted only after multi-view geometric and temporal validation. Each evaluation unit contains appearance reference images, a held-out real target video, an editable digital twin, a matched proxy render, and renderer-native scene annotations. We evaluate transfer models against paired real target videos, retain PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections, and use scene annotations to localize failures by object, visibility, articulation, and motion. The first release retains 12 of 14 registered samples (85.7%), comprising 1,496 paired real-proxy frames. All released scenes pass file-integrity and environment-edit audits, while proxy diagnostics yield a depth si-RMSE of 0.2170 and instance mIoU of 0.3673. RenderBench provides paired real observations and editable scene state for assessing both appearance fidelity and preservation of geometry and dynamics.

articles.title_zh: Render Bench: 以重建后的数字双胞胎为基准进行Render-to-Real视频传输
articles.content_zh: 现代的视频模型可以从真实的外观参考中生成现实的视频,代理则使视频能够指定场景结构,视角变化,以及运动. 评估这种渲染到现实的能力需要真实的目标视频来描绘相同的场景演化,并配以可编辑,几何注册的3D复制品. 这种数据传统上需要大量人工制作、校准和动画。 我们引入了Render Bench, 以12个重建现实世界的场景为基准, 这些场景跨越了大规模的室内环境和自我中心观点, 既有静态的,也有动态的。 我们的建筑管道结合了视觉几何,神经重建,并协助了3D的编写. 每个场景被分解为静态物体和动态演员,注册在捕捉相机上,并在多视几何和时间验证后才能接受. 每个评价单位都包含外观参考图像、被搁置的真目标视频、可编辑的数字双胞胎、匹配的代理渲染和渲染器-内景说明。 我们对照配对的真实目标视频来评价传输模型,保留PAI-Bench-C相容的结构预测,并使用场景说明来通过对象,能见度,表达和运动来本地化故障. 第一次发布保留了14个已登记样本中的12个(85.7%),包括1 496个对正副相框。 所有公布的场景都通过文件集成和环境编辑审核,而代理诊断结果的 si- RMSE 深度为 0.217,例 mIoU 为 0.3673. Render Bench提供配对真实的观测和可编辑的场景状态,用于评估外观是否忠贞并保存几何和动态.

articles.title: EC-RAG: Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long Video Understanding
articles.content: Current large video-language models (LVLMs) still face challenges when dealing with long videos, mainly because frames are often processed independently, making it difficult to capture temporal dependencies across events. Although retrieval-augmented approaches have been introduced to provide additional context, most of them operate at the frame or snippet level, which limits their ability to model how events evolve over time and relate to each other. In this paper, we propose Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (EC-RAG), a training-free framework that organizes video content into an explicit event chain before question answering. Instead of retrieving isolated frames or text segments, EC-RAG first partitions the video into semantically coherent segments, represents each segment using multi-modal signals, and then links them into a structured chain that preserves temporal order and captures inter-event relationships. Given a query, the system identifies relevant events within this chain and gathers supporting evidence from the associated modalities. Our approach offers several practical advantages: (i) event-level abstraction that better reflects how video content is naturally structured, enabling more reliable localization compared to frame-level retrieval; (ii) structured multi-modal fusion that aggregates speech, text, and visual cues at the event level, allowing complementary information to be more effectively utilized during reasoning; and (iii) plug-and-play compatibility with existing LVLM backbones, requiring no additional training or reliance on proprietary models. Experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench show that this event-centric design consistently outperforms frame-level retrieval baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling temporal structure for long-video understanding.

articles.title_zh: EC-RAG: 事件链检索-增强生成用于长视频理解
articles.content_zh: 当前的大型视频语言模型(LVLMs)在处理长视频时仍然面临挑战,这主要是因为帧常常是独立处理的,因此很难捕捉到跨事件的时间依赖性. 虽然采用了可检索的方法来提供额外的上下文,但大多数方法都运行在框架或片段层面,这限制了它们模拟事件如何随时间演变和相互关联的能力. 在本文中,我们提出事件链检索增强生成(EC-RAG),这是在回答问题之前将视频内容组织成明确事件链的无培训框架. EC-RAG没有检索到孤立的帧或文本片段,而是首先将视频分解成集成相通的片段,使用多模式信号代表每个片段,再将它们链接到一个结构化的链条中,保持时间顺序并捕捉事件间的关系. 考虑到一个查询,该系统确定这一链条内的相关活动,并从相关模式收集佐证证据。 我们的方法提供了几个实际的优点:(一)事件层次抽象,更好地反映视频内容如何自然结构化,使得比帧层次检索更可靠地本地化;(二)结构化多式聚变,将语音,文字,和视觉提示在事件层次集中起来,使辅助信息在推理过程中得到更有效的利用;(三)与现有的LVLM主干网兼容,不需要额外的培训或依赖专有模式. 关于Video-MME,MLVU,和LongVideo Bench的实验表明,这种以事件为中心的设计一贯优于帧级回取基线,突出了模拟时间结构对长视频理解的重要性.

articles.title: PDB: Point-Based Deformation Blending for Facial Animation Retargeting
articles.content: Mesh-agnostic facial animation retargeting transfers expressions across meshes with different structures, but preserving facial motion without surface artifacts remains challenging. To address this, we present PDB, Point-Based Deformation Blending for facial animation retargeting. PDB predicts a compact set of deformed control points from a source neutral-expression pair and blending weights from the target neutral mesh. The weights are computed once per target and reused across frames, while the control points vary with each source expression. ReLU enforces non-negative weights and permits exact zeros, followed by row-wise normalization. The target mesh is reconstructed directly by multiplying the weights and control points, without a predefined cage, precomputed coordinates, a learned per-element deformation decoder, or a global reconstruction solve. Trained only with self-retargeting reconstruction supervision, PDB supports cross-identity transfer without paired cross-identity training expressions. Experiments demonstrate accurate retargeting, fast inference, and localized support in the learned weights. Joint evaluation of expression accuracy and local surface preservation shows reduced surface artifacts relative to the evaluated dense displacement method while retaining the intended motion. Perceptual evaluations further support expression fidelity and visual quality in both self- and cross-retargeting.

articles.title_zh: PDB:以点为基点的变形组合来进行面部动画再瞄准
articles.content_zh: 网格-不可知面部动画以不同结构在网格间重新定位传输表达方式,但保护面部运动而无地表文物仍然具有挑战性. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出PDB, 点基变形混合 面部动画重定向。 PDB从源中性表达对和从目标中性网格混合重量中预测出一组紧凑的变形控制点. 权重是每个目标计算一次并跨帧再利用,而控制点则随每个源表达而有差异. ReLU执行非负重并允许精确为零,然后是行向正常化. 目标网点通过相乘重量和控制点来直接重建,没有预定义的笼子,预计算坐标,学习到的每个元素变形解码器,或者全球重建解决方案. PDB只接受自重目标重建监督的训练,支持跨身份传输,不配对跨身份培训表达. 实验显示准确的重定向,快速推论,以及所学重量的局部支持. 对表达精度和当地地表保存的联合评价显示,相对于评价的密集迁移方法,表面文物在保留预定运动的同时有所减少。 观念评价进一步支持自我和交叉目标方面的表达忠诚和视觉质量。

articles.title: Knowing When to Trust a Prior: Reliability-Gated Cue Fusion for Video Gaze Prediction
articles.content: Video gaze prediction is led by gaze-trained models, yet gaze-free priors carry signal those models have not absorbed, if one knows when to trust them. We propose FocusGate, a gated ensemble of gaze-free priors whose members may abstain. A per-frame gate reads three shape statistics of a defocus map and selects the frames on which the estimator is above chance on average, so rejected frames reduce to the base exactly, while midrank normalisation lets an all-zero prior abstain at zero parameters. Gated fusion is significantly positive on film, sports and web video, whereas unconditional fusion is harmful on sports and null on web. Added to four supervised predictors, the NTIRE 2026 champion among them, FocusGate improves all sixteen model-domain cells in shuffled AUC, fifteen significantly, one domain pre-registered and scored once, while adding only 1% to the champion's latency. Alone, it surpasses TASED-Net and UNISAL in shuffled AUC on film with a 16-frame causal mean.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 了解何时信任一个前题: 视频 Gaze 预测的可靠性- 配音
articles.content_zh: 视频目光预测是由目光训练模型所引导的,然而无目光前传则携带着这些模型没有被吸收的信号,如果人们知道何时可以相信它们的话. 我们提议FocusGate, 一个有门的无目光的前科组合, 其成员可以弃权。 每帧门读取了去聚焦图的三个形状统计,并选择了估计器平均高于概率的帧,因此被否决的帧完全缩小到基数上,而中位态的正态化则让一个在零参数上全0前弃权. 在电影、体育和网络视频中,加特聚变明显阳性,而无条件聚变则有害于体育,在网络上是无效的。 加上4个受监督的预测器,其中NTIRE 2026冠军,"FocusGate"在被洗牌的AUC中改进了所有16个模型域细胞,15个显著,1个域预先注册并得分一次,同时给冠军的休息时间只增加了1%. 仅此而已,它就超越了TASED-Net和UNISAL,在影片中用16个框架的因果平均值对AUC进行洗牌。

articles.title: Selective Transfer of RL Updates for Visual Reasoning
articles.content: Model merging provides a training-free way to transfer reasoning capabilities from language models to vision-language models (VLMs), but endpoint-based transfer can conflate pre-existing model differences with changes acquired during reasoning post-training. We instead formulate capability transfer around the training-stage update, isolating the parameter changes induced by reinforcement learning (RL). Yet transferring this update in full remains suboptimal: we find that its components differ substantially in cross-model transferability, with dominant directions transferring more effectively than the complete update. Based on this finding, we introduce Selective-RL, which isolates the RL-stage update, retains its dominant matrix-wise directions with magnitude preservation, and transfers them to the language modules of a VLM. Across three model families and five visual-reasoning benchmarks, Selective-RL improves full-update interpolation in 12 of 15 comparisons, including an 8.55 percentage-point MathVision gain on the Qwen recipient. Matched controls show that update magnitude or arbitrary low rank alone does not reproduce these gains. These results highlight a distinction between what is acquired during post-training and what remains transferable across models, providing a training-stage perspective on cross-model capability transfer. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/selective-rl.

articles.title_zh: 为视觉原因选择传输 RL 更新
articles.content_zh: 模型合并提供了将推理能力从语言模型转移到视觉语言模型(VLMs)的无培训方式,但基于端点的转移可以将先前存在的模型差异与推理后训练中获得的变化相混淆. 相反,我们围绕培训阶段的更新制定能力转让,孤立强化学习引起的参数变化。 然而,全面转移这一更新仍然不够理想:我们发现其组成部分在跨模型可转移性方面差异很大,主要方向转移比完整更新更有效. 基于这一发现,我们引入了Selective-RL,它隔离了RL级的更新,保留了它的主矩阵方向并有规模保全,并转移给VLM的语言模块. 在三个模范家庭和五个视理基准中,Selective-RL改进了15个比较中的12个的全更新插值,包括奎恩接受者8.55个百分点的数学视野增益。 相匹配的控件表明,仅更新的幅度或任意的低排名并不能复制这些收益. 这些成果突出了在培训后获得的东西与仍然可跨模式转让的东西之间的区别,为跨模式能力转让提供了一个培训阶段视角。 守则见https://anonymous.4open.science/r/select-rl。

articles.title: Stable Scores, Unstable Answers: Frame Phase and Option Order in Video Multiple-Choice Evaluation
articles.content: Video-language models are ranked by multiple-choice accuracy on frames from a uniform grid. The grid has two parameters, a rate and a phase, and benchmarks report only the rate. The phase moves answers: two deployed samplers differing only by a half-step phase offset answer 23.6% of questions differently while scoring within a point, and across four releases from two families shifting only the phase changes roughly one answer in five after controlling option order. PHASEFUSION decodes three offset grids and averages the option posteriors. The grids are the polyphase components of the dense grid. Fusion matches a 32-frame single pass in accuracy within a prespecified margin (logit-scored) and cuts the answers a half-step shift of all three grids changes from 18.2% to 10.1%. Option order, which changes only the presentation, is flagged instead by a one-pass answer margin. Report the phase convention with the budget, or marginalize it.

articles.title_zh: 稳定的分数,不稳定的答案:视频多选择评价中的框架阶段和选项顺序
articles.content_zh: 视频语言模型从一个统一的网格上按帧上的多选择精度排序. 电网有两个参数,一是速率和相相,基准只报告速率. 阶段移动答案:两个部署的采样员只因半步阶段的不同而不同,抵消了不同问题的回答率的23.6%,而在一个点内打分,在两个家庭的4个释放单元中,只转移阶段,在控制选择顺序后,大约五分之一的答案会改变。 PHASEFUSION解码出三个相抵网格,并平均选项后缀. 网格是密集网格的多相构件. 组合匹配一个32个帧的单子在预设比值(logit-scored)内的精确度,并且将所有三个网格的答案从18.2%切入到10.1%的半步变化. 选择顺序只改变列报方式,而是用一个单行接答比值标出。 以预算报告阶段公约,或将其边缘化。

articles.title: Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection
articles.content: As generated images become increasingly realistic, reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information. However, existing methods primarily rely on task-specific supervision to adapt vision foundation model representations, without fully exploiting internal forensic knowledge to guide detection. To address this limitation, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE), a framework that treats sparse, origin-sensitive internal components in pretrained models as a forensic reserve and translates their localization into structural constraints for lightweight adaptation. Specifically, we first use the Forensic Lens (F-lens) to decompose activations across layers and token groups into independent components and globally screen them by their response differences between real and generated images, identifying reserve sites and directions. Next, we map the selected directions back to hidden-state space to construct fixed reserve subspaces and insert Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA) only at the identified sites. Finally, with the backbone parameters, previously fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases fixed, we train only the FRA coefficient maps to generate input-dependent residual updates constrained to the corresponding subspaces, strengthening existing forensic responses. Using only 500 labeled training images and a trainable parameter budget below 0.2% of the backbone, RGE achieves competitive performance across three detection benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation. Furthermore, RGE consistently improves over the corresponding frozen detectors across eight encoders spanning self-supervised and vision-language pretraining, eliciting a latent forensic capacity broadly shared across pretrained vision models.

articles.title_zh: 法证储备:为图像伪造侦测而学习Lateent知识
articles.content_zh: 随着生成的图像变得越来越现实,可靠的伪造检测对于维持对视觉信息的信任至关重要. 然而,现有方法主要依靠特定任务的监督来调整愿景基础模型表述,而未充分利用内部法医学知识来指导检测. 为了消除这一局限性,我们提议保留指导的Eligarian(RGE),这个框架将预先训练过的模型中稀有的、对起源敏感的内部组件作为法证储备,并将其本地化转化为轻量级适应的结构性限制。 具体地说,我们首先使用"法证镜头"(F-lens)将跨层和象征组的活化分解为独立的组件,并通过真实图像和生成图像之间的反应差异进行全球筛选,确定保留地和方向. 其次,我们将选定方向映射回隐藏状态空间,以建造固定的后备子空间,并仅在确定的地点插入法医后备适应器。 最后,在主干参数、先前安装的参考分类器和已固定的子空间基准下,我们只培训FRA系数图,以生成受相应子空间制约的依赖输入的剩余更新,加强现有的法证反应。 RGE仅使用500个标有标记的训练图像和低于主干线0.2%的可训练参数预算,在没有目标基准调整的情况下,实现了三个检测基准的竞争性性能. 此外,RGE在8个编码器中不断改进相应的冷冻探测器,这些编码器跨越自我监督和视觉语言的预训,在预先训练的视觉模型中广泛共享潜在的法证能力。

articles.title: LiDAR Resolution Recovery via Foundation-Model-Guided Diffusion
articles.content: High-beam-count LiDAR sensors are costly, yet many perception pipelines require dense angular sampling. Using a pretrained Stable Diffusion model as the backbone, we fine-tune a LiDAR-conditioned depth model with pseudo-depth targets from a 2D foundation model. During training, the LiDAR conditioning is randomly decimated at different beam budgets. We then investigate how much of a LiDAR scan can be recovered from heavily decimated input and characterize performance across the input beam budget. We evaluate against physically held-out real beams on nuScenes and report recovery separately from fit accuracy. Our model yields its largest advantage in very sparse regimes, achieving a $δ_{1.25}$ accuracy of $66.8$% from $4$-beam input where scattered interpolation reaches only $45.1$%. A class-stratified error breakdown further reveals that planar surfaces recover first while objects introducing depth discontinuities degrade earliest. Together, these results quantify the recovery/resolution trade-off for foundation-model-guided LiDAR enhancement.

articles.title_zh: LiDAR 通过Foundation-Model-Guided Divation 解析回收
articles.content_zh: 高梁计数 LiDAR传感器成本很高,但许多感知管需要密集的角取样. 以预训稳定分流模型为骨干,从2D基础模型中微调出有伪深度目标的LiDAR条件深度模型. 在训练期间,LiDAR调制在不同的光束预算上被随机歼灭. 然后我们调查LiDAR扫描能从大量大量消耗的输入中回收多少,并描述整个输入束预算的性能. 我们对照核磁场上的实相束进行评估,并报告恢复情况与适当的准确性分开。 我们的模型在非常稀少的政权中获得了最大的优势,从4美元波束输入的精度达到66.8%,而分散的插值只达到45.1%。 分类分解的误差进一步表明,平面首先恢复,而引入深度不连续的物体最早降解。 这些结果共同量化了对基础模型指导的LiDAR增强的恢复/分辨率取舍。

articles.title: FedDermaSeg: Federated Learning for Dermatological Image Segmentation
articles.content: Skin cancer is a major global health concern, and early detection and accurate lesion delineation are important for effective diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated skin lesion analysis can assist dermatologists, with lesion segmentation serving as a fundamental step in computer-aided diagnostic systems. Conventional deep learning-based segmentation models typically rely on centralized training, where images and their corresponding segmentation masks are collected on a central server. Such data aggregation raises privacy concerns in medical applications and requires substantial centralized computational resources. To address these limitations, we investigate the feasibility of federated learning for privacy-preserving skin lesion segmentation. The training and validation sets of the ISIC 2018 Skin Lesion Segmentation Challenge dataset are used to simulate a distributed learning environment and develop a federated segmentation model. The resulting model is evaluated on the ISIC 2018 test set and the PH2 dataset to assess its performance and generalizability. Experimental results demonstrate that the federated model achieves performance comparable to centralized training while consistently improving upon the locally trained models. These findings demonstrate the potential of federated learning for collaborative skin lesion segmentation without requiring centralized aggregation of medical images.

articles.title_zh: Fed DermaSeg: 皮肤学联合会 图像分割
articles.content_zh: 皮肤癌是全球主要的健康关切,早期发现和准确的病情划定对于有效的诊断和治疗规划十分重要. 皮肤损伤自动分析可以帮助皮肤科医生,损伤分解是计算机辅助诊断系统的一个基本步骤. 常规深层学习分解模型一般依靠集中式训练,在中央服务器上收集图像及其相应的分解口罩. 这种数据汇总在医疗应用中引起隐私问题,需要大量的集中计算资源。 为了克服这些局限性,我们调查了联合学习保护隐私的皮肤损伤分化的可行性。 ISIC 2018 Skin Lesion分流挑战数据集的培训和验证集被用于模拟分布式学习环境并开发联合分流模型. 由此产生的模型在国际标准行业分类2018年测试集和PH2数据集上得到评价,以评估其性能和通性. 实验结果表明,联邦模式的绩效与集中培训相当,同时在当地培训模式上不断改进。 这些研究结果表明,在不需要集中汇总医疗图像的情况下,可以联合学习合作进行皮肤损伤分解。

articles.title: Sparse2comm: Towards Robust Cooperative 3D Object Detection
articles.content: Cooperative perception improves autonomous driving by sharing complementary observations among vehicles and roadside infrastructure for 3D object detection. However, practical deployment is constrained by limited bandwidth and unreliable cooperation, where packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment jointly degrade the cooperative feature stream. Existing methods often reduce communication cost or compensate for one degradation type, leaving coupled disturbances insufficiently addressed. To address this problem, we propose Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient and robust cooperative 3D object detection framework that treats unreliable cooperation as progressive restoration over degraded cooperative features. Sparse Feature Encoding first encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features transmitted by collaborating agents, from which the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations. This sparse-to-dense mechanism learns to infer missing object-centric content from sparse observations, enabling ultra-low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery within the same representation. On the semantically restored features, Latency-Aware Alignment predicts motion flow to compensate delayed messages, and Self-Calibrating Fusion estimates residual spatial offsets in a self-supervised manner before adaptive cross-agent fusion. Sparse2comm therefore restores semantic completeness, temporal consistency, and spatial alignment in an ordered pipeline. Extensive experiments on DAIR-V2X, OpenV2V, and V2V4Real show that Sparse2comm maintains competitive clean accuracy and consistently improves robustness under individual and mixed real-world degradations. Compared with the selective feature communication baseline Where2comm, Sparse2comm improves mixed-setting AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by +20.15/+11.79, +12.66/+11.07, and +15.36/+12.61 on the three datasets, respectively.

articles.title_zh: Sparse2comm 主题 : 大力合作三维对象检测
articles.content_zh: 合作感知通过在车辆和路边基础设施之间共享3D物体检测的补充观测结果来改善自主驾驶. 然而,实际部署受到带宽有限和不可靠的合作的限制,因为包丢失、传输延迟和空间错位共同使合作特征流退化。 现有方法往往会降低通信成本或补偿一种退化类型,使混合扰动问题得不到充分解决。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议建立Sparse2comm,这是一个带宽高效和强有力的合作三维物体探测框架,将不可靠的合作视为逐步恢复已退化的合作特征。 Sparse Feature Encoding首先将通信编码为由协作者传输的随机口罩样本前地特征,自负载体从中重建了密集语义表达. 这种从零到多的机制从稀少的观测中可以推断出缺失的以物体为中心的内容,从而能够在同一代表范围内进行超低波段的交流并恢复数据包的损失。 在被模拟恢复的特征上,Latency-Aware对接预测了运动流来补偿被延迟的信息,而自解融合在适应性交叉物剂聚变之前,以自我监督的方式估计了剩余空间相抵. 因此,Sparse2comm恢复了语义完整性、时间一致性和所订购管线的空间对接。 对DAIR-V2X,OpenV2V,和V2V4 Real的广泛实验表明,Sparse2comm保持了竞争性的清洁精度,在个体和混合的活地退化下持续地提高稳健性. 与选择性特征通信基线Where2comm相比,Sparse2comm将混合设置的AP@0.5/AP@0.7分别改进为+20.15+11.79,+12.66/+11.07和+15.36/+12.61三个数据集.

articles.title: Less Is More: A Leakage-Controlled Study of Dermoscopic Preprocessing for Joint Skin Lesion Classification and Segmentation with YOLO26
articles.content: Handcrafted preprocessing is widely employed in automated dermoscopic analysis to suppress imaging artifacts and enhance lesion visibility. Nevertheless, its actual contribution to modern real-time models remains unclear, particularly when evaluation protocols do not adequately control correlations among images of the same lesion. This study presents a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint evaluation of dermoscopic preprocessing and augmentation for joint multi-class lesion classification and instance segmentation using a fixed nano-scale YOLO26 segmentation model (YOLO26n-seg). From HAM10000 (10,015 images), quality control yields 10,013 valid image-mask pairs from 7,468 unique lesions, partitioned into mutually exclusive sets by lesion identity. With the architecture, resolution, training budget, and evaluation protocol held fixed, we compare minimally processed images plus online augmentation against offline class balancing, DullRazor-CLAHE preprocessing, and raw-processed hybrid views, over three random seeds. On the lesion-disjoint test set, the raw baseline achieves a mask mAP$_{50:95}$ of $0.5636 \pm 0.0234$, a Dice score of $0.9356 \pm 0.0024$, and a macro-F1 score of $0.6917 \pm 0.0202$. Offline augmentation does not improve the mean performance, while the combined and hybrid strategies reduce both class-aware segmentation and classification accuracy. At only 2.69 million parameters, the model runs at approximately 50 frames per second. Under a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint protocol with all non-input factors held fixed, minimally processed dermoscopic images combined with standard online augmentation deliver a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than increasingly complex deterministic preprocessing, which yields no consistent joint benefit across three seeds on HAM10000.

articles.title_zh: Less Is More:由渗出控制进行的皮肤分级预处理研究
articles.content_zh: 手工预处理被广泛用于自动皮肤分析,以抑制成像文物并增强损伤能见度。 尽管如此,它对现代实时模型的实际贡献仍然不明确,特别是在评价协议不能充分控制同一种损伤的图像之间的相关性时。 本研究采用固定纳米尺度的YOLO26分化模型(YOLO26n-seg),对皮肤预处理和增强进行渗出控制、损伤-分解评价,以便进行多类联合损伤分类和实例分解。 从HAM1000(10,015个图像)中,质量控制从7,468个特有损伤中产生10,013个有效图像掩码对,通过损伤身份被分割成相互排斥的组合. 随着架构、解析度、培训预算和评价协议的固定, 我们比较了最小处理的图像 加上在线增强 和离线类平衡, DullRazor-CLAHE预处理, 以及原始处理的混合视图, 超过三个随机种子。 在损伤-脱节测试集上,生平基线实现口罩mAP$_{50:95}$0.5636\pm 0.0234美元,地斯得分0.9356\pm 0.0024美元,宏观-F1得分0.6917\pm 0.0202美元. 离线增强不会改善平均性能,而结合和混合战略既会降低班级认知分化,也会降低分类精度. 该模型仅以269万个参数运行,每秒运行约50帧. 根据渗漏控制、损伤-脱节协议,所有非输入因子都持有固定的、经过最小处理的外观图象,加上标准的在线增强,比日益复杂的确定性预处理更能提高准确性-效率的取舍。

articles.title: Have I Seen Enough? Frozen Video-Language Models Encode Evidence Readiness
articles.content: Streaming video-language models must decide not only what to answer, but whether the evidence needed for the current question has arrived. Existing systems learn that decision as a separate trigger; we ask whether an unmodified model already computes it. We show that frozen VideoLLMs carry a linearly readable evidence-readiness signal, labelled from timestamped evidence rather than from model output. It decodes in all seven models of a shared byte-identical evaluation (AUROC 0.733-0.905 under the strictest not-ready sampling, where a fitted clock is near chance), and a probe fitted without any of a benchmark family's footage still reads that family. It is question-conditioned: on byte-identical windows, changing only the question reverses the readout on 66.1% of pairs, while every question-blind control is at chance by construction. The model can answer incorrectly and still encode readiness: AUROC remains 0.722 among wrong answers. Readiness also beats uncertainty estimators and their supervised combination on latency-matched answer selection, and tracks independent human judgments more closely than confidence. Released streaming triggers are also linear readouts, yet a trained trigger read on its own base model's activations is approximately orthogonal to readiness and decodes it far less accurately than a probe. We turn the readout into Readiness Gating, an answer-timing policy that improves accuracy by up to +9.75 pp at matched video duration with negligible computational overhead. How much it gains varies with the accuracy headroom the task makes available: across 26 configurations the gain tracks that headroom, and an intervention that moves it over identical pixels moves the gain with it.

articles.title_zh: 我看够了吗? 冷冻视频语言模型编码证据准备状态
articles.content_zh: 流传的视频语言模型不仅必须决定答案是什么,还必须决定当前问题所需的证据是否已经到来. 现有系统将这一决定作为一个单独的触发器来学习;我们询问一个未经修改的模型是否已经计算出来. 我们显示,被冻结的VideoLLMs带有线性可读证据-准备状态信号,标注在时间印出的证据上,而不是模型输出上。 它解码了所有七个同字节相同评价模型(AUROC 0.733-0.905在最严格的不准备采样的情况下,安装的时钟几乎是偶然的),安装的探测器没有基准家庭的任何镜头仍然读取该家庭。 这个问题是有条件的:在字节相同的窗口上,只改变问题就将66.1%的对子的读取结果倒置,而每个问题盲控制都有可能通过构建实现. 该模型可以错误地回答,并且仍然编码准备:AUROC在错误的回答中仍然是0.722. 准备状态也比不确定性估计器及其监督结合在随机应变的答案选择上要好,并比信心更密切地跟踪独立的人类判断。 被放出流线性触发器也是线性读取器,然而在自己的基型上读取的被训练有素的触发器的活化度大约是正向的,并且解码远不及探测器准确. 我们把读出改为 " 准备状态 " (Ready Gating),这是一种答案计时政策,在相匹配的视频时间长度和可忽略不计的计算间接费用的情况下,提高准确度,达到+9.75页。 其收益因任务提供的准确度而异:在26个配置中,其收益轨迹为头室;在相同像素上移动其收益的干预则随其移动.

articles.title: RSJEV: Discriminative Remote Sensing Scene Classification with Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.content: Remote sensing scene classification is a fundamental task in Earth observation and geospatial analysis. Existing approaches mainly follow three paradigms: task-specific visual classification, vision-language similarity matching, and autoregressive multimodal generation. However, visual classifiers rely on predefined label spaces, CLIP-based methods perform recognition through static image-text alignment, and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) introduce unnecessary token-level generation for classification tasks with explicit candidate categories. To address these limitations, we propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for remote sensing scene classification. Unlike conventional MLLMs that formulate classification as autoregressive text generation, RSJEV reformulates scene classification as a candidate-conditioned multimodal discriminative decision process, where visual representations, task instructions, and candidate category semantics are jointly modeled. Specifically, we introduce a OnePass Decider that extracts multimodal decision states and directly estimates category probabilities within the candidate category space, eliminating autoregressive decoding while preserving vision-language interactions. Extensive experiments on three widely used remote sensing scene classification benchmarks, including UC Merced, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45, demonstrate that RSJEV achieves superior classification performance compared with representative CNN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, RSJEV significantly reduces inference costs and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off with only a compact 0.8B-parameter model. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of state-conditioned multimodal decision making for efficient remote sensing image understanding. The code will be available at https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV.

articles.title_zh: RSJEV:带有多式大型语言模型的歧视性遥感场景分类
articles.content_zh: 遥感场地分类是地球观测和地理空间分析中的一项基本任务. 现有方法主要遵循三个范式:任务特有视觉分类,视觉语言相似性匹配,自相递减多模式生成. 然而,视觉分级者依赖于预定义的标签空间,基于CLIP的方法通过静态图像-文本对接来进行识别,而多模式大语言模型(MLLM)引入了不必要的符号级生成,用于分类任务,并有明确的候选类别. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议建立遥感场景分类的一通多式决策框架RSJEV。 与常规的MLLMs将分类归为自递式文本生成不同,RSJEV将场景分类重新设定为可选条件的多式差别化决策流程,其中可视化表达,任务指令,和可选类语义共同建模. 具体地说,我们引入了“一个决定者”,它提取了多种模式的决定状态并直接估计了候选类别空间内的类别概率,消除了自旋解码,同时保持了视觉语言的互动。 对三个广泛使用的遥感场景分级基准(包括UC Merced、AID和NWPU-RESISC45)进行的广泛实验表明,与有代表性的CNN-、变形器-、曼巴-、CLIP-和基于MLLM的方法相比,RSJEV的分级性能更高。 此外,RSJEV还大幅降低了推论成本并仅用紧凑的0.8B参数模型实现了更好的精度效率取舍. 这些结果表明,有条件的多式联运决策对于高效的遥感图像了解是有效的。 该守则可在https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV上查阅。

articles.title: Beyond Perturbation Magnitude: Direction-Dependent Responses in Multimodal Geometric Representations
articles.content: Geometric alignment scores based on Gram determinants provide a compact way to model higher-order consistency among modalities, yet how such scores respond to modality degradation is poorly understood. This paper asks whether the response of a multimodal geometric score is determined primarily by the magnitude of the perturbation-induced displacement. Using frozen cohorts from MSR-VTT (N=878) and DiDeMo (N=980), we apply controlled video blur and audio noise and analyze the response in the relational geometry on which the score is defined. Displacement magnitude explains at most 15% of the out-of-sample variance in the absolute response, and magnitude-matched pairs respond systematically differently, so scalar magnitude does not organize the response. The closed-form first-order expansion of the Gramian volume yields the Directional Geometric Response (DGR): the projection of the displacement onto the local volume gradient, which jointly captures the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and displacement direction. The absolute first-order DGR term explains the observed response with out-of-sample R^2 of 0.838-0.969, matched-magnitude ranking accuracies of 0.864-0.963, and response-sign accuracies of 0.909-0.989, whereas the tested direction-free alternatives remain weak or unstable under the corresponding evaluation protocols. A pre-specified gain-normalization candidate, V/(g_V+eps), fails its predictability and clean-order gates. DGR uses the observed degraded-state displacement and is therefore an explanatory quantity, not a deployment-time predictor: geometric response depends on where the representation operates, how far degradation moves the relational geometry, and in which direction it moves.

articles.title: MedCORE: Criteria-Grounded Clinical Reasoning for Interpretable Medical Image Diagnosis
articles.content: Clinical diagnosis is inherently a structured reasoning process, yet existing deep learning models often bypass this structure by mapping image features directly to disease labels without explicitly interrogating the morphological and textural criteria that clinicians systematically evaluate. This limits diagnostic transparency and may compromise safe clinical deployment. We present MedCORE (Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence), a structured diagnostic framework that operationalizes clinical reasoning within a vision-language architecture. For each input image, MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic process into clinically defined criteria, spatially localizes each criterion to diagnostically relevant image regions, encodes evidence through multi-scale representations that capture macro-structural and micro-textural pathological characteristics, and refines criterion representations using a Graph Attention Network that explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies. Criterion representations are further aligned with clinical text descriptors, reinforced through class-wise visual prototypes, and aggregated using uncertainty-calibrated weighting that proportionally discounts low-confidence diagnostic evidence. MedCORE is validated across three clinically heterogeneous imaging modalities, including dermoscopic lesion classification on ISIC 2018, breast ultrasound lesion characterization on BUSI, and diabetic retinopathy grading on IDRiD. Quantitatively, MedCORE achieves 89.2% accuracy, 85.7% macro-F1, and 96.4% AUC on ISIC 2018; 96.1% accuracy, 95.2% macro-F1, and 98.4% AUC on BUSI; and 84.3% accuracy, 80.2% macro-F1, and 92.8% AUC on IDRiD. These results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CNN, transformer, biomedical vision-language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines.

articles.title_zh: MeDCORE:可解释性医疗图像诊断的标准全方位临床理由
articles.content_zh: 临床诊断本质上是一个有条理的推理过程,然而现有的深层学习模型往往绕过这种结构,将图像特征直接映射到疾病标签上,而没有明确询问临床医生系统评价的形态和纹理标准. 这限制了诊断透明度,并可能损害安全的临床部署。 我们介绍了MedCORE(医学标准 -- -- 面向理性和证据),这是一个结构化的诊断框架,在视觉语言架构中实施临床推理。 对于每个输入图像,MedCORE将诊断过程分解成临床定义的标准,在空间上将每个标准分解为诊断相关的图像区域,通过多尺度的表示来编码证据,能够捕捉宏观结构特征和微观文字病理特征,并使用一个图形注意网络来完善标准表示,该网络明确模拟标准之间的依赖性. 标准表述进一步与临床文本描述符相匹配,通过分级视觉原型来强化,并使用不确定性校正加权法进行汇总,以比例折扣低自信诊断证据. MedCORE通过三种临床多样的成像模式得到验证,包括2018年国际标准行业分类的皮肤损伤分类、BUSI的乳房超声波损伤特征鉴定和IDRID的糖尿病肾上腺病分级鉴定。 在数量上,MedCORE在2018年国际标准行业分类上达到89.2%的精度,85.7%的宏-F1和96.4%的AUC;在BUSI上达到96.1%的精度,95.2%的宏-F1和98.4%的AUC;在IDRID上达到84.3%的精度,80.2%的宏-F1和92.8%的AUC. 这些结果表明,相对于强大的有线电视新闻网、变压器、生物医学视觉语言、基于概念和以原型为基础的基线,情况持续改善。

articles.title: WareFly-VLA: A Vision-Language-Action Framework for UAV Navigation and Human Tracking in Smart Warehouses
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive results in robotic manipulation and ground-mobile navigation, yet language-conditioned control of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in smart warehouses remains largely unexplored, hindered by the lack of benchmarks that jointly provide continuous low-level flight actions, fine-grained natural-language target descriptions, and realistic industrial environments. This paper introduces WareFly-VLA, a photorealistic UAV VLA framework and dataset for language-guided human search, localization, and tracking in warehouse environments. It contains 507 human-teleoperated flight episodes and 8,504 high-resolution RGB transitions collected in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each paired with a human-written appearance description of the target worker and a synchronized four-degree-of-freedom control command. Two aerial tasks are covered: target approach and person following, under occlusion, long-range search, altitude variation, and clutter. A unified benchmark of four open-source VLA architectures (SmolVLA, GR00T N1.7, pi_0 and OpenVLA) is established under a leakage-free episode-level protocol at two control rates. The results show that language-conditioned aerial control in warehouses is far from solved: performance drops substantially under strict generalization settings, continuous action modeling consistently outperforms discrete action tokenization, only the forward channel is reliably learnable from a single frame, and current foundation-model interfaces transfer poorly from ground and humanoid embodiments to aerial platforms. The synchronized video, language, action, pose, and difficulty annotations further support world-model research. The dataset, baselines, and evaluation protocol are released to support language-grounded aerial autonomy in smart warehouses.

articles.title_zh: WareFly-VLA:智能仓库无人驾驶飞行器导航和人类跟踪的远景-语言-行动框架
articles.content_zh: 远景-语言-行动模型在机器人操纵和地-地导航方面取得了令人印象深刻的成果,但智能仓库中对无人驾驶飞行器(无人驾驶飞行器)的以语言为条件的控制仍然基本上没有得到探讨,因为缺乏共同提供持续低水平飞行行动的基准、精细的自然语言目标描述以及现实的工业环境。 本文介绍了WareFly-VLA,这是一个光现实化的UAV VLA框架和数据集,用于语言引导的人类搜索,本地化,以及仓库环境中的跟踪. 它包含507个由人操作的飞行事件和由NVIDIA Isaac Sim所收集的8,504个高分辨率RGB过渡,每组都配有目标工人的人文外观描述和同步四度自由控制指令. 涉及两项航空任务:目标接近和跟踪人员,在隔离、远程搜索、高度变化和杂乱无章地进行。 由四个开源的VLA架构(SmolVLA,GR00T N1.7,pi_0和OpenVLA)的统一基准,在一个无渗出插曲级协议下以两个控制速率建立. 结果显示,仓库内语言条件的空中控制远未解决:在严格概括的设置下,性能大幅下降;连续的动作模型持续地超过离散动作符号化;只有前方通道能够可靠地从一个框架学习;目前的地基模型界面从地面和人造地表到航空平台的传输不良. 同步视频,语言,动作,姿势,和难度说明进一步支持了世界模型研究. 发布数据集、基线和评价协议,以支持智能仓库中基于语言的航空自主权。

articles.title: 2D Spatial Reasoning with Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata
articles.content: Many modern learning approaches are still struggling with spatial reasoning tasks, i.e. they lack the ability to utilize geometric information of perceived entities and their spatial relation to each other to solve problems. We introduce a novel Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata (aNCA) architecture which uses deformable convolutions to dynamically adapt the perceptive field and iteratively reason over 2D spatial relations on grid-like data structures (e.g. images). Empirical results on public benchmarks show state of the art comprehensible results with high generalization abilities for solving image based puzzles like Sudoku or finding the shortest path in a maze.

articles.title_zh: 2D 空间理性与适应性神经细胞自发
articles.content_zh: 许多现代的学习方法仍然在努力完成空间推理任务,即缺乏利用被感知的实体的几何信息及其彼此的空间关系来解决问题的能力. 我们引入了一款小说"适应性神经细胞自動"(ANCA)架构,该架构使用可变形的回旋来动态地使感知场和迭代理性适应于网格等数据结构(如图像)上的2D空间关系. 公共基准的实证结果显示了艺术的可理解性,具有高通化能力,可以解决以图像为基础的谜题,如"数"或"找到迷宫中最短的路径".

articles.title: Knee3DVLM: Dual-Sequence Full-Volume Vision-Language Modeling for Comprehensive Knee MRI Assessment
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being applied to three-dimensional medical imaging, but their application to knee MRI remains limited, particularly for interpreting the complementary sequences used in clinical practice. We introduce Knee3DVLM, a sequence-aware VLM that uses full-volume DESS and fluid-sensitive TSE MRI to predict 57 anatomically resolved binary diagnostic targets derived from the MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) for structured reporting. We evaluated DESS-only, TSE-only, and paired DESS-TSE configurations using subject-disjoint Osteoarthritis Initiative partitions. In a held-out cohort of 1,074 examinations, the fused model achieved 72.98% average accuracy, 71.17% balanced accuracy, 78.96% mean ROC-AUC, and 78.74% macro ROC-AUC, the highest values among the three configurations. In a secondary multiclass analysis aligned with the released 3DReasonKnee cohort, Knee3DVLM was numerically higher than the strongest reported 3DReasonKnee configuration across five pathology categories. These findings support dual-sequence full-volume modeling for comprehensive knee MRI assessment.

articles.title_zh: Knee3DVLM: 为综合膝盖磁共振进行双序全卷视野-语言建模 评估
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)越来越多地被应用于三维医学成像,但是它们对于膝盖核磁共振的应用仍然有限,特别是用于解释临床实践中使用的补充序列. 我们介绍Knee3DVLM,一种有序列意识的VLM,它使用全容量的DSS和流体敏感的TSE核磁共振来预测57个解剖解的二进制诊断目标,取自MRI Osteoarthis Knee Score(MOAKS),用于结构化报告. 我们只评价了DSS, TSE, 并用主题-脱节性骨炎倡议分区对DSS-TSE配置进行配对。 在被搁置的1 074次考试中,引信模型的平均准确度达到72.98%,平衡准确度达到71.17%,平均ROC-AUC达到78.96%,宏观ROC-AUC达到78.74%,这是三种配置中的最高值。 在一项与释放的3个DREasonKnee组群相一致的二级多类分析中,Knee3DVLM在数字上高于5个病理类中报告的最强3个DREasonKnee配置. 这些调查结果支持综合膝盖核磁共振评估的双序全量模型。

articles.title: HuC-VideoMAE: Human-Centric Video Masked Autoencoding from synthetic data
articles.content: Modern action recognition models rely on video transformers pretrained on massive collections of web-crawled videos, such as Kinetics-700. However, the use of such data raises ethical concerns, as subjects' consent is typically not obtained. Recent high-quality synthetic video datasets generated from motion-capture data, such as BEDLAM2.0, offer a promising ethical alternative. In this work, we investigate self-supervised pretraining of video transformers on synthetic human-motion datasets. We first show that directly applying the standard VideoMAE masking strategy leads to substantially worse performance than pretraining on Kinetics. To address this limitation, we propose a human-centric masking scheme that leverages body keypoints and person bounding box regions. Our approach encourages the model to focus on the structure and dynamics of human motion during pretraining. Experiments on NTU RGB+D and Toyota-Smarthome demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms standard VideoMAE pretraining on synthetic data, closing 49% of the gap to Kinetics pretraining on NTU RGB+D cross-view-subject without using a single real frame during pretraining. To promote the use of ethical action recognition models, we will publicly release our pretrained models.

articles.title_zh: HuC-VideoMAE:人文科 视频蒙面 从合成数据自动编码
articles.content_zh: 现代动作识别模型依赖于视频变压器预先对大量收集的被网络绘制的视频进行训练,例如Kinetics-700. 然而,使用这种数据引起了伦理方面的关切,因为一般得不到主体的同意。 最近从动作捕捉数据中生成的高质量合成视频数据集,如BEDLAM2.0,提供了一个很有希望的伦理选择. 在这个作品中,我们调查了对合成人-运动数据集的视频变压器进行自我监督的预训. 我们首先表明,直接应用标准的VideoMAE口罩策略会导致比对Kinetics的预训更糟糕的性能. 为了解决这一限制,我们提议了一个以人为中心的蒙面图谋,利用身体的关键点和人定边框区域。 我们的做法鼓励该模式在训练前注重人类运动的结构和动态。 NTU RGB+D和丰田-斯玛特霍姆的实验表明,我们的方法大大超过了合成数据的标准VideoMAE预训,关闭了49%的空白到Kinetics预训NTU RGB+D交叉取景主体,在预训期间没有使用单个真实框架. 为了推广使用道德行动识别模式,我们将公开发布我们经过预先培训的模式。

articles.title: Deformable CT-US Registration via Anatomy-Aware Implicit Neural Representations
articles.content: Slice-to-volume registration between ultrasound (US) and preoperative computed tomography (CT) imaging would enhance many minimally invasive interventions, for example by locating soft tissue structures intra-operatively that are discernible in CT. While optical tracking enables initial rigid registration, contact from the probe induces soft tissue deformations that inhibit accurate alignment. In this work, we introduce a deformable CT-ultrasound registration framework that incorporates anatomical priors derived from CT to improve registration under deformation. Rigid registration is first established using a robot-assisted optical tracking system, after which a deformable transformation is estimated using a sinusoidal implicit neural representation (SIREN) optimized per frame. Tissue stiffness is approximated from CT-based HU values and used as spatially varying regularization, suppressing deformation in rigid structures such as bone while allowing more flexibility in soft tissue. Two additional constraints capture the physics of probe contact: a contact-zone displacement prior that drives the displacement field to compress tissue below the probe face, and a fan-geometry regularization term based on beam direction and convex transducer field of view. Model parameters are optimized with a normalized gradient field (NGF). The proposed approach improves alignment over rigid initialisation by 17% and outperforms classical deformable baselines while maintaining near-zero topological folding.

articles.title_zh: 通过解剖学-智能隐性神经表达法进行可变形的 CT-US 注册
articles.content_zh: 超声波成像(美国)和术前计算成像(CT)之间的切片到体积登记将加强许多最小的侵入性干预,例如通过在术后确定在CT中可见的软组织结构。 虽然光学跟踪可以进行初步的硬化登记,但从探测器接触会诱发软组织变形,抑制准确的对接. 在这项工作中,我们采用了可变形的CT-超声波登记框架,其中包括从CT中得出的解剖学前科,以改善变形下的登记。 刚性注册首先使用机器人辅助光学跟踪系统建立,之后使用每个帧最优化的sinusoidal隐性神经表达(SIREN)来估计可变形的转化. 组织硬度取自基于CT的HU值相近并用作空间相异的正态,抑制了骨等刚性结构的变形,同时使软组织具有更大的灵活性. 有两个额外的制约因素捕捉出探针接触的物理:一个是接触区位移先驱使出行场将组织压缩到探针面下方,另一个是基于光束方向和对流转子视场的扇形几何规范化术语. 模型参数被优化为正态梯度字段(NGF). 拟议的方法使调整比刚性初始化改进了17%,并超越了古典可变形基线,同时保持了近于零的地貌折叠.

articles.title: From the Drosophila Visual Connectome to General-Purpose Computer Vision
articles.content: Biological connectomes encode structured solutions to visual computation that may provide reusable inductive biases for artificial vision. We develop ConnectomeX around FlyVision, a trainable architecture that preserves parallel ON/OFF processing, recurrent computation and population-level graph interaction while scaling model capacity across tasks. FlyVision reached 99.34% accuracy on MNIST with 80,608 parameters and 78.03% on CIFAR-10 with 81,408 parameters. On ImageNet-1K, FlyVision Base and Large reached 60.79% and 66.25% top-1 accuracy with 1.8 and 3.7 million parameters, while a Large local-k7 model with a learned low-frequency branch reached 66.53%, compared with 69.25% for ResNet18 with 11.7 million parameters. On a 22-class skin-disease benchmark, FlyVision Large achieved 63.78% accuracy and 95.28% macro-AUROC with 2.99 million parameters. In four-class chest radiography, ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Base and Large reached 92.60% and 92.76% accuracy with 1.33 and 2.97 million parameters, compared with 91.56% for ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18 with 11.18 million. BrainAGE extends FlyVision to volumetric T1-weighted MRI by applying a shared ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Large encoder to 24 sagittal, coronal and axial slices per scan and combining slice-level age estimates by confidence-modulated Gaussian voting. On 433 held-out scans, three-axis fusion achieved a mean absolute error of 5.98 years and R^2 = 0.868. Across the 224x224 classification tasks, the best FlyVision configuration remained within three percentage points of ResNet18 on ImageNet-1K and skin-disease classification and exceeded it on chest radiography with substantially fewer parameters. These results show that a conserved connectome-informed computation can scale from compact recognition to large-scale natural and biomedical vision.

articles.title_zh: 从 Drosophila 视觉连接器到通用计算机视觉
articles.content_zh: 生物连接体将结构化的解决方案编码为视觉计算,可能为人工视觉提供可再使用的导出偏差. 我们围绕"FlyVision"开发了ConnectomeX,这是一种可训练的架构,它保留了并行的ON/OFF处理,经常性的计算和人口级图表交互,同时将模型能力提升到跨任务. FlyVision在MNIST上达到99.34%的精度,有80,608个参数,在CIFAR-10上达到78.03%,有81,408个参数. 在ImageNet-1K上,FlyVision Base and Large的精度达到60.79%和66.25%,拥有180万个参数和370万个参数;而拥有学有学有学的低频分支的大型本地-k7模型则达到66.53%,而ResNet18的精度达到69.25%,拥有1,170万个参数. 在22级皮肤病基准上,"FlyVision Lig"取得了63.78%的精度和95.28%的宏AUROC,参数为299万. 在四级胸腔辐射图中,ImageNet预装Flyvision Base and Ligh的精度达到92.60%和92.76%,参数分别为133和297万;而ImageNet预装ResNet18的精度为91.56%,为1 118万. BrainAge将FlyVision扩展至体积T1加权磁共振,方法是将共享的ImageNet预受训练的FlyVision大型编码器应用到每次扫描的24个相干,冠状和轴状切片上,并用置信调制的高斯投票来将切片级年龄估计结合起来. 在被搁置的433个扫描中,三轴核聚变实现了5.98年和R^2=0.868. 在224x224的分类任务中,最佳FlyVision配置仍保持在ResNet18关于ImageNet-1K和皮肤病分类的3个百分点以内,在胸腔射线学上超过了这个比例,参数少得多. 这些结果显示,保存的连接体知情计算可以从紧凑的识别到大规模的自然和生物医学视觉。

articles.title: Ariadne's Thread of LipSync: Unraveling Forgeries via Inconsistency between Lip Motions and Head Poses
articles.content: Recent advances in LipSync generation technology have led to the creation of highly realistic videos, posing severe societal risks. However, existing defense strategies struggle against LipSync forgeries, as advanced LipSync generation methods not only achieve better lip synchronization but also eliminate visual artifacts. An important reason is that they overlook an inherent biological coupling between lip movements and head poses in natural speech videos. In this paper, we propose LipDA, a novel framework for joint LipSync Detection and Attribution, which takes advantage of the inconsistency between head and lip. For detection, the framework learns to quantify this discrepancy by contrasting lip and pose features from authentic versus forged videos. For attribution, our method is designed to capture the unique temporal dynamics and audio-visual synchronization patterns that act as the fingerprint of models, enabling source tracing. We conduct extensive experiments on two challenging LipSync datasets as well as our own proposed large-scale and multi-generator dataset. LipDA achieves over 97\% AUC in detection and 97.5\% accuracy in model attribution, significantly outperforming existing methods. Code and the proposed LipSync-A dataset are available at https://github.com/AnsonShe/LipDA.

articles.title_zh: Ariadne's Thread of LipSync: Lip Moments 和 Head Poses之间通过不一致来解脱活性
articles.content_zh: 近期LipSync生成技术的进步导致制作出非常现实的视频,造成了严重的社会风险. 然而,现有的防御策略与LipSync伪造相抗衡,因为先进的LipSync生成方法不仅实现了更好的唇同步,而且消除了视觉文物. 其中一个重要原因是他们忽略了自然语音视频中唇动和头部相接的固有生物结合. 在本文中,我们提出LipDA,这是联合LipSync检测和分配的新框架,它利用了头和唇之间的不一致. 为了侦测,框架通过对比口语来学习量化这种差异,并呈现出真实和伪造视频的特征. 对于归属,我们的方法旨在捕捉作为模型指纹的独特时间动态和视听同步模式,使源头追踪成为可能. 我们对两个具有挑战性的LipSync数据集以及我们自己提出的大规模多源数据集进行了广泛的实验. articles.title: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding for Privacy-Friendly AIoT
articles.content: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding (IBFU) aims to directly perform fine-grained classification and semantic description generation from encoded image byte sequences. In contrast to conventional pixel-domain visual understanding, IBFU conducts semantic analysis without fully decoding images into the pixel domain. Since pixel-level visual content is not explicitly reconstructed during inference, this paradigm reduces visual exposure within the processing pipeline and suits privacy-friendly Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) applications. In this paper, we propose Bitstream Fine-grained Generator (BFG), a novel foundation model tailored for IBFU. BFG consists of two main components: a Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE) and a Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG). BSeE directly models semantic representations from encoded image bitstreams without explicit pixel reconstruction, while FSeG transforms the extracted bitstream semantics into detailed natural-language descriptions through autoregressive generation. To train BFG and comprehensively evaluate IBFU in practical AIoT scenarios, where image bitstreams may suffer corruption during transmission and storage, we construct a large-scale Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D), containing both intact bitstreams and corrupted variants across multiple corruption types and severity levels. Experiments show that BFG maintains stable fine-grained caption generation under bitstream corruption. For example, the performance only has slight change from 0.6339 to 0.6077 in terms of average CIDEr score on Stanford Dogs Caption dataset, while vision-language models, such as Qwen-VL-Chat, BLIP-2, GLM, Gemini, and GPT suffer severe performance decrease. This paper provides a practical paradigm for privacy-friendly fine-grained understanding in AIoT.

articles.title_zh: 图像 Bitstream 对隐私的精细理解- 友好AIoT
articles.content_zh: 图像 Bitstream Fine-Grained Conference (IBFU) 旨在从被编码的图像字节序列中直接进行精细分级和语义描述生成. 与常规像素-域视觉理解相反,IBFU进行语义分析时没有将图像完全解码到像素域. 由于像素层面的视觉内容在推论期间没有被明确重建,这个范式减少了处理管道内的视觉曝光并适合隐私友好的人工智能(AIoT)应用. 在本文中,我们提出Bitstream Fine-Grained Generator(BFG),这是为IBFU量身定制的新式基础模型. BFG由两大部分组成:一是Bitstream语义编码器(BSeE),一是精致的语义生成器(FSeG). BSeE直接从编码的图像比特流中进行模型语义表达,没有明显的像素重建,而FSeG则通过自递生成将所提取的比特流语义转化为详细的自然语言描述. 为了培训BFG并在实用的AIoT情景中全面评价IBFU,即图像比特流在传输和存储过程中可能遭受腐败,我们构建了一个大规模被腐蚀的比特流精细分辨数据集(CFU-D),包含完整比特流和腐败变体,跨越多类腐败和严重程度. 实验显示,BFG在比特流腐败下保持了稳定的精细字幕生成. 例如,从斯坦福犬科Caption数据集的平均CIDER得分来看,性能只有从0.6339到0.6077的微小变化,而视觉语言模型如Qun-VL-Chat,BLIP-2,GLM,双子座和GPT的性能严重下降. 本文为AIOT中方便隐私的精细理解提供了实用的范式.

articles.title: Decoy and disclosure radii of invariant shape descriptors
articles.content: A recognizer that compares rotation-invariant descriptors sees a surface only up to the fiber of the descriptor. We measure this fiber by its radius in the orbit distance from the enrolled surface. A large radius admits decoys, that is, distant shapes that pass the matcher. A small radius discloses the enrolled shape to anyone who captures the stored value. For star-shaped surfaces truncated to spherical harmonics of degree at most $L$, with $n$ coefficients, a descriptor of generic rank $r$ has generic fibers of dimension $n-3-r$ modulo rotations. The standard pool of band powers, even bispectra, and three invariants of the degree-three band therefore admits decoy families of dimension $5$, $13$, $20$ at $L=4,6,8$. Its rank first reaches $n-3$ at $L=16$, and a mirror decoy remains at every $L$. The odd bispectra remove the mirror decoy generically for $L \geq 4$. Yet at fixed mean radius the same pool determines the enclosed volume exactly, and it does not determine whether a surface meets a clearance requirement. We certify two cases by exact and interval arithmetic. At $L=6$ a decoy matches all $32$ invariants to relative precision $2 \cdot 10^{-18}$ at orbit distance at least $0.87$ times the norm of the enrolled tuple. For the radar shape model of asteroid (101955) Bennu, the pool recovers the modeled volume, misses the handedness, and leaves the keep-out radius uncertain by more than $7 \, \mathrm{m}$.

articles.title: GeoPID: Decomposing and Steering Visual Information in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: While recent vision-language models (VLMs) have shown outstanding performance across diverse applications, they tend to under-use visual information and over-rely on textual context. In this work, we propose \textsc{GeoPID}, a training-free framework that analyzes multimodal information within VLMs from a geometric perspective. \textsc{GeoPID} decomposes information into Redundant, Modality-Unique, and Synergistic components through the geometric relationships between visual and textual representation subspaces. Through an extensive analysis across 22 VLMs and 14 benchmarks, we confirm that correct predictions exhibit stronger vision-unique components when questions strongly require visual grounding. Building on this geometric analysis, we introduce a targeted intervention technique that selectively amplifies visual representations along the vision-unique subspace during inference. As a result, visual grounding capabilities were enhanced without any additional model parameter updates, achieving an average relative accuracy gain of 7.63\%.
